descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 30 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Get Ready to Dive into the Ultimate Clubbing Experience!

GO CLUBBING VR puts you at the centre of the party — anytime, anywhere. Join dancers from around the world as you explore jaw-dropping virtual venues, from rooftop lounges to lunar pool parties. With live DJ sets, customizable avatars, and real-time social vibes, the party never stops.

Whether you're reliving your rave days or starting new ones, GO CLUBBING delivers immersive clubbing experiences designed for music lovers, dancers, and creatives alike.

-🎧 Features:
- 🌍 Global multiplayer VR dancefloors
- 🎧 Live DJ performances streamed into the app
- 💃 Beat-synced avatars with body & hand tracking
- 🎨 Custom avatar outfits & effects
- 🪩 Themed parties, virtual festivals & live events
- 🎟️ NFT  VIP content (coming soon)

No queues. No dress code. Just pure connection and music.

Join early ravers already inside. Available now on Meta Quest.
